evidence_excerpts: On single-operator benchmarks, Ansor performs best or equally best in all operator and batch-size settings and outperforms existing search frameworks by 1.1x to 22.5x.
On subgraph benchmarks, Ansor outperforms manual libraries and other search frameworks by 1.1x to 14.2x.
text: Ansor outperforms existing search frameworks and manual libraries on single-operator and subgraph benchmarks across evaluated cases.
